name: Glow
description: Rounded corners and a window border with a soft glow halo. A multipass demo: buffer0.frag box-blurs the captured surface into a downscaled glow source, and effect.frag lays that blurred surface as a soft halo in and around the border band, on top of the same rounded-corner / border clip as the Border pack. Static (no time-based animation); radius, width and colour come from the host.
author: PlasmaZones
